user_text: Plan a 1-day migration from SVN to Git for a small repo.
assistant_text:
## SVN → Git Migration (1-Day Plan)

**Prerequisites:** Git, `git-svn`, and admin access to both repos.

---

### Morning (2–3 hrs): Prep

- [ ] **Audit SVN repo** — check size, branches, tags, externals
- [ ] **Create authors file** — map SVN usernames to Git identities
  ```
  jsmith = John Smith <jsmith@example.com>
  ```
- [ ] **Provision bare Git repo** (GitHub/GitLab/Gitea/self-hosted)
- [ ] **Notify team** — freeze SVN commits during migration window

---

### Midday (2–3 hrs): Clone & Convert

```bash
# Standard trunk/branches/tags layout
git svn clone https://svn.example.com/repo \
  --stdlayout \
  --authors-file=authors.txt \
  --no-metadata \   # omit if you want git-svn-id in commits
  -s my-repo

cd my-repo

# Convert SVN tags to real Git tags
git for-each-ref refs/remotes/tags | cut -d / -f 5- | while read tag; do
  git tag "$tag" "refs/remotes/tags/$tag"
  git branch -r -d "tags/$tag"
done

# Convert SVN branches to local Git branches
git for-each-ref refs/remotes | grep -v tags | cut -d / -f 4- | while read branch; do
  git checkout -b "$branch" "refs/remotes/$branch"
done
```

---

### Early Afternoon (1 hr): Verify

- [ ] Commit count matches (`git log --oneline | wc -l`)
- [ ] Branches and tags present (`git branch -a`, `git tag`)
- [ ] Spot-check 3–5 commits for author, message, diff accuracy
- [ ] Check `svn:externals` — **convert manually** to Git submodules or subtrees

---

### Late Afternoon (1 hr): Push & Cut Over

```bash
git remote add origin git@github.com:org/my-repo.git
git push origin --all
git push origin --tags
```

- [ ] Set default branch (`main`)
- [ ] Configure branch protection rules
- [ ] Update CI/CD pipelines to point to Git
- [ ] **Make SVN repo read-only** (or add commit hook blocking new commits)

---

### End of Day (30 min): Team Handoff

- [ ] Share Git clone instructions with team
- [ ] Brief on Git workflow (especially if team is SVN-heavy)
- [ ] Archive SVN repo URL in README or wiki

---

### Key Risks

| Risk | Mitigation |
|---|---|
| Missing authors | Pre-validate authors file before clone |
| `svn:externals` | Manually convert; don't skip |
| Large binary history | Consider `git-lfs` or `--no-metadata` + shallow |
| Long clone time | Run overnight if repo is large |

From the migration plan:

1. **`svn:externals`** — no automatic conversion; breaks builds if missed
2. **Missing authors** — clone fails or produces malformed commits
3. **Long clone time** — large/old repos can take hours, blowing the 1-day window

**Migration Risk Checklist**

- [ ] Authors file complete and validated before clone
- [ ] All `svn:externals` identified and conversion plan ready
- [ ] Repo size estimated; clone time acceptable within window
Keep SVN read-only (not deleted) — revert CI/CD pointers back to it if Git migration fails.
`git-svn` installed on the machine running the migration.

**1-Day SVN → Git Migration Recap**

- **Prereq:** `git-svn` installed, authors file ready
- **Steps:** Prep → Clone → Verify → Push → Cut Over
- **Top risks:** Missing authors, `svn:externals`, long clone time
- **Validation:** Compare commit counts
- **Rollback:** Keep SVN read-only
- **Approval:** Team/project lead
- **Comms:** Announce SVN freeze in advance

- Prep authors file and install `git-svn`
- Clone, convert branches/tags, verify commit count
- Push to Git, make SVN read-only
- Team lead approves cutover
- Announce freeze time early
